annotations.title: Request a call from a specialist

description: Ask Fast Fibre to call the person about fiber internet at their address. Only when the person asked you to, with their own name and mobile number — never guess them. Before calling this tool, tell the person and get their yes to: "The person asked their AI assistant to request a call from Fast Fibre about fiber internet at this address, and agreed that Fast Fibre may call them at this number to confirm the request." Then set user_confirmed to true. A specialist calls usually the same day to confirm the request; nothing is ordered until the person confirms on that call. Relay the message in the result to the person, with the confirm link if there is one.

agent.description: Your name as an assistant, e.g. "ChatGPT" or "Claude"

best_time.description: When the person prefers a call

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it

phone.description: The person's 10-digit US mobile number, as they gave it. Never guess it.

plan.description: "500" = 500 Mbps, "1g" = 1 Gig, "2g" = 2 Gig, "help" = not sure yet (default)

situation.description: "xfinity" = switching from Xfinity, "other" = from another provider, "moving" = moving in / no internet

street.description: House number and street, e.g. "511 Azalea St"

user_confirmed.description: true only after the person asked you to request the call and agreed to this: The person asked their AI assistant to request a call from Fast Fibre about fiber internet at this address, and agreed that Fast Fibre may call them at this number to confirm the request.

name: request_callback
title: Request a call from a specialist
